description: This bar chart illustrates the Macro f-score values for the RECA model across different frequency categories. The horizontal axis represents the frequency categories—High, Medium, Low—and is labeled accordingly, with categories appearing in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Macro f-score,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Four orange bars are presented, each corresponding to a frequency category; the “High” frequency bar has a value of 0.837, the “Medium” frequency bar has a value of 0.538, the “Low” frequency bar has a value of 0.114, and the gray bar representing RECA for “High” frequency has a value of 0.877. The bars are arranged in order of the frequency categories listed on the horizontal axis, and the chart includes a legend identifying the bars as representing “RECA” and a gray bar with no label.
